title.en: Tale 4 — The Smell of the Food

book_meta.author: traditional
book_meta.status: public domain — folk material, no known author

source: retold in modern Hebrew by Claude — NOT native-validated

sentences.en: A poor man passed beside a restaurant.

sentences.ar: היה לו רק לחם יבש ביד.
sentences.en: He had only dry bread in his hand.
He stood beside the door and ate.
The smell of the meat reached him.
The owner of the restaurant came out and shouted at him.

sentences.ar: הוא אמר: אתה אוכל עם הריח שלי.
sentences.en: He said: you are eating with my smell.

sentences.ar: הוא אמר: תשלם לי על זה.
sentences.en: He said: pay me for it.

sentences.ar: האיש אמר: אין לי כסף בכלל.
sentences.en: The man said: I have no money at all.
They went to the judge in the city.
The judge that day was Juha.
He heard both of them quietly.

sentences.ar: הוא אמר: זה עניין חשוב מאוד.
sentences.en: He said: this is a very important matter.

sentences.ar: הוא ביקש מהעני את הכיס שלו.
sentences.en: He asked the poor man for his pocket.
In it were two small coins.
Juha took them in one hand.

sentences.ar: הוא הזיז את היד ליד האוזן.
sentences.en: He moved his hand beside the ear.
A sound of money moving was heard.
He returned the coins to the poor man.
He said to the restaurant owner: did you hear?
He said: that is your payment.

sentences.ar: הוא אמר: ריח בשביל קול הכסף.
sentences.en: He said: a smell for the sound of the money.
